name: Refresh Trim Restorer

ad.headline: Restore & Protect
ad.description: Bring back that deep, rich black appearance to all non-painted exterior plastic, vinyl and rubber surfaces. Formulated to restore faded, weathered trim to its original, showroom-new appearance. The non-greasy formula dries quickly and will not streak when treated surfaces get wet. Shake well and apply a dime-sized drop trim restorer to a clean, cool surface using a microfiber foam applicator pad.
benefits: Simply apply and wipe off for that showroom look.
